result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but a few elements look clipped or obscured, especially around horizontally scrolling sections and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the content area. The second restaurant card in “Popular right now” is cut off behind the bottom tab bar, making the lower part of the card and its text unavailable in the current view.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content equal to the bottom navigation height plus safe-area inset so cards can scroll fully above the nav.

issues.description: The category chip row shows a partially visible blank/unstyled pill on the far right edge, which looks like a broken or empty filter chip.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partially visible carousel items contain visible text/icons, or adjust horizontal padding/snap behavior so cropped chips do not appear empty.

issues.description: Items in the “Fastest near you” carousel are clipped on the right side, including the third restaurant image and name. While this may indicate horizontal scrolling, it looks abrupt because the card text is cut mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Use clearer carousel spacing or snap points, or fade the right edge to communicate that the row scrolls horizontally.
